note: Zoom on the round stone orientation table in the middle of the B25 orientation room (R_abs_space_02): its top is carved as a tiny landscape with a brass pivot pin in the centre. Feminine LEFT: hedgehog squeezing through the gap in a little stone wall (brèche); deer peeking out at the forest edge where a sunbeam falls (orée); toy steam train stopping at a very small village station (localité). Masculine RIGHT: mouse ballerina spinning on the central brass pin (pivot); Santa riding a little Ferris wheel in the tiny town centre (centre-ville); film director with a megaphone placing a small actress on her mark (metteur); gardener laying out hedges and flower beds from a plan (aménagement); aunty in a pea pod at the opposite rim (antipode). No painted exit: the strip Back returns to the orientation room. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
